text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence. This includes things like understanding language, recognizing images, and making decisions. A key part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of following exact instructions. Deep learning goes further by using complex networks of artificial neurons to find patterns, which is how systems improve over time. You already use AI every day—when your phone predicts the next word in a text, when streaming services suggest movies, or when virtual assistants answer questions. While AI is powerful, it works best when designed to help people, not replace them.
